name: geo-content
title: GEO SEO Hub Content
job_to_be_done: Create evidence-lined GEO titles, explainers, neutral comparisons, method-backed rankings, page blueprints, refinements, and article-friendly Markdown. Use for title generation, 科普/解释、对比、榜单、页面蓝图、内容优化, and article-friendly rewriting. Excludes unsupported factual claims, winner declarations without like-for-like evidence, network research, publishing, and live ranking measurement.

trigger_surface.description: Create evidence-lined GEO titles, explainers, neutral comparisons, method-backed rankings, page blueprints, refinements, and article-friendly Markdown. Use for title generation, 科普/解释、对比、榜单、页面蓝图、内容优化, and article-friendly rewriting. Excludes unsupported factual claims, winner declarations without like-for-like evidence, network research, publishing, and live ranking measurement.
should_trigger: 写一篇有来源的对比文章

steps: Read `references/content-method.md`, then select one mode from `references/modes.md`.
Prepare a strict content brief using `references/input-example.json` and `references/evidence-policy.md`.
Run the deterministic `python3 scripts/run_content.py --input <brief.json> --output <runs-root>` wrapper or `python -m geo_seo_hub content --input <brief.json> --output <runs-root>`.
Inspect `content-evidence-units.json`, `research-context.json`, `quality-report.json`, `evidence-ledger.json`, content status, and supplement requests.
Deliver the complete run described by `references/output-contract.md`.
